instruction: Navigate to gnome-look.org, obtain the Nordic theme, and use it as your GTK theme.

metadata.explanation: This variation requires installing and activating the Nordic GTK theme from gnome-look.org. The evaluator verifies the theme using gsettings gtk-theme setting. Similar difficulty to the original Orchis theme task. Verified that gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface gtk-theme returns the active theme name.
